title: Every member index header carries the same small pastel pill and small plain pill

source.ref: Daniel 2026-10-19 design list (30 items), items 28 and 30

detail: Cohesion pass, first cut. Circles, Channels, Market and Classifieds headers drop their large pills for the small ones Spaces and the shared header already use (btn pa sm / btn sm). Events' operator link drops the glass pill left over from the dark hero. Around You and Members stop hand-writing Tailwind primary buttons and use buttonClasses('primary', 'sm'); Housing's header buttons go from md to sm. Remaining cohesion work (one EmptyState, one toolbar class, PageHeading in the hand-rolled heads, kit bodies for Store, Housing, Members and Around You, Frequency loading states) follows in the next cohesion PRs; loading states ride LIVE-1032.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];for(const p of ['components/frequency/members/circles/circles-body.tsx','components/frequency/members/channels/channels-body.tsx','components/frequency/members/marketplace/marketplace-body.tsx','components/frequency/members/events/events-body.tsx']){if(/\"btn pa lg\"|\"btn lg\"|\"btn glass sm\"/.test(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8')))bad.push(p+' has a large header pill')}for(const p of ['app/(main)/nearby/page.tsx','app/(main)/network/page.tsx']){if(fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').includes('rounded-control bg-primary px-4 py-2'))bad.push(p+' hand-writes a primary button')}if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-1031: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
verify.note: Fails when an index header grows its own button size or a hand-written primary button. Behavior is index-actions.test.ts.
